name: Zalashji's Den
summary: Along Tanaris's eastern shore, Zalashji keeps to a lonely cave in the bluffs.

sections.title: A Solitary Lair
sections.body: Zalashji lives alone in a cave on Tanaris's eastern shore. While naga across Kalimdor gather in war parties or coastal outposts, he has made his home in this isolated cavern, far from the region's settlements and desert ruins. Travelers following the surf should approach the cave mouth with caution. Why Zalashji chose this place is unknown.

faq.answer: Zalashji's Den lies in the rocky bluffs beside the ocean on Tanaris's eastern coast.
Zalashji is a naga who lives alone in a coastal cave, apart from larger naga forces.

faq.q: Are there any quests associated with this cave?
faq.answer: No known tasks lead adventurers to Zalashji's Den. The cave remains a landmark for travelers along Tanaris's eastern shore.

faq.q: Why is a naga living alone in Tanaris?
faq.answer: Zalashji's motives are unknown. Naga usually gather near sunken ruins or in organized encampments, while he lives alone in a seaside cave.

angles.text: As a night elf, the cursed and mutated naga along Kalimdor's shores recall the ancient Highborne and the Sundering.
